params.body:
## Why

No source page exists on gentells.com, so every source link stamped into a report ends on "Not found". The launch cover hid this until `sources/*` was let through it on 20 November 2026.

`gentells:reconcile` on production says why:

```
cited sources: SQLSTATE[22001]: String data, right truncated: 1406 Data too long for column 'date'
```

One source in a report's list carries a remark as its date ("from 2026-09-09 (per search snippet)"), 36 characters in a column of 32. The cited sources are written in one transaction, so that one row took every page with it, on every run since the list was held.

## What

In `Projection::reconcileCitedSources`:

- The date kept is the date in the field: a year, a year and month, or a full day. A field with no date in it gives none. The page shows a date, not a remark about how it was found.
- A publisher name is clipped to the column.

No migration: the column is wide enough for what is now stored.

## Checked

- `CitedSourcePageTest`: a new case syncs a remark with a date in it, a year and month, a remark without a date and a bare year; all four pages are held, and the page shows "9 September 2026" without the remark.
- Full suite 667 of 668 locally; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which looks for the checkout's git folder and finds none in a worktree. Pint clean.

## After merge

```bash
php artisan gentells:reconcile     # expect "cited sources: N pages"
```

The same remark still sits in the Observatory's list for that report (Going Out, Staying In, source 5); tidying it there is editorial and changes nothing for this fix.
params.title: Source pages: a remark in the date field no longer stops the sync
